title: DNS client
subtitle: Have the server perform a resolution on your behalf and inspect the full message details

form.serverHelp: Enter this-server to resolve recursively on this machine, or provide any IP, host:port, or https:// DoH endpoint.
form.protocolHelp: UDP is the most compatible. DoH, DoT and DoQ require the target server to support the corresponding port.
form.dnssecHelp: Sets the AD bit in the request. The server returns signatures and validation status.
form.eDnsClientSubnetHelp: Optional. The client subnet disclosed to upstream resolvers, used to obtain closer CDN answers.
form.importHelp: Write the resolution results to the server as zone records.
form.importWarning: Records go into an existing primary or conditional-forwarder zone that matches. If no zone matches, the server creates a new primary zone for the domain.

importConfirm.title: Add as zone record
importConfirm.body: Every record in this response is written to the server. If no existing zone matches, a new primary zone for “{domain}” is created. This cannot be undone.

result.title: Resolution result
result.empty: Fill in the query parameters and click Resolve
result.emptyHint: The result shows the full DNS message, including the question, answer and EDNS option sections.
result.noAnswer: The server returned no answer records
result.noAnswerHint: Response code was {rcode}. The name may not exist or was blocked by policy.

edns.none: No EDNS options in the message

raw.title: Raw response
raw.hint: The full message text returned by the server, useful for field-by-field troubleshooting.
raw.multiple: {count} segments (one per hop on the recursion path)

history.title: Session query history
history.hint: Stored only in this browser's localStorage; never sent to the server.

bulk.title: Bulk resolve
bulk.subtitle: Run the same query parameters against multiple domains
bulk.domainsHelp: One domain per line, up to {max}.
bulk.tooMany: Too many domains. The maximum is {max}.
